answer: A stake-weighted work inlet forces each agent to lock collateral before joining, so creating many fake identities multiplies cost instead of influence. Like basalt columns that only form under sustained pressure, reputation accrues slowly through attested work and decays if idle, so a Sybil farm cannot shortcut trust. A mesa of verified history stands above fresh accounts: new identities start with near-zero weight and must earn it, making mass forgery expensive and slow.
